features.feature: Delivery partner registration with personal details
features.functionality: Name, mobile, email, DOB (18+), gender, address, vehicle type and number, emergency contact; field-by-field validation; one partner per mobile number (duplicate-mobile check).
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026

features.functionality: Consent recorded (version, time, IP) before any check; PAN via the KYC provider (encrypted, masked); Aadhaar by OTP (masked + keyed token only, DB check refuses a stored number); Verified / Pending / Failed; admin decides by hand.
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026
features.remaining: Aadhaar OTP against the live provider (Test-site keys answer only saved examples); consent wording legal review

features.feature: Police verification form and character certificate upload
features.functionality: PDF/JPG/PNG from the bytes; max size rule riderVerification.maxDocumentBytes (5 MB); encrypted in the database (no public bucket); admin Uploaded / Under review / Approved / Rejected with reason; audited file opening.
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026

features.functionality: Device location requested on the form; submission blocked without it with a clear message; latitude, longitude and time saved.
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026

features.functionality: availability column; only Ready gets new offers; Active/Ready blocked until PAN+Aadhaar Verified and both documents Approved, unless an admin overrides.
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026
features.switchedOn: On by default (rules riderVerification, riderZoning, orderCompletion, deliveryOtp.required)
features.remaining: Decide gate on/off at release (existing riders need KYC + documents or an admin override)

features.feature: Zoning: pickup and delivery within 3–5 km
features.functionality: Rule riderZoning (default 5 km, min 3, max 5) on the live location for pickup and drop; stale location ignored; offers re-checked on each location update and at acceptance.
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026
features.switchedOn: On by default (rules riderVerification, riderZoning, orderCompletion, deliveryOtp.required)
features.remaining: Decide zoning on/off at release (orders whose customer is >5 km from the shop wait for a rider between them)

features.feature: Shop owner view of authorised and blocked societies
features.functionality: Admin authorises / blocks a partner per society; shop page Delivery partners shows counts and lists on tap.
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026

features.feature: Hide partner identity for blocked societies
features.functionality: Server side: shop order data, photo access and shop notifications never carry a blocked partner's name, photo or mobile — 'Partner pending assignment'; blocked partners kept off that society's orders.
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026

features.functionality: Assigned → Picked Up with timestamp; optional pickup photo (delivery_proofs.kind PICKUP); shop and customer notified.
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026

features.functionality: Picked Up → Delivered; OTP configurable (deliveryOtp.required), photo proof by deliveryProof.photoRequired.
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026
features.switchedOn: On by default (rules riderVerification, riderZoning, orderCompletion, deliveryOtp.required)

features.functionality: orders.completed_at on confirmed delivery (status stays DELIVERED); order.completed → push + SMS + in-app to customer and shop (rule orderCompletion).
features.whereItRuns: Production (gokesari.com) and Test site since 31 Oct 2026
features.switchedOn: On by default (rules riderVerification, riderZoning, orderCompletion, deliveryOtp.required)
features.remaining: Completion SMS needs an SMS provider; push needs rule push on and the app installed
